title: WMG EVOLVES GLOBAL LEADERSHIP TO DRIVE NEXT PHASE OF GROWTH
summary: Alejandro Duque and Guillermo Gonzalez promoted, Elliot Grainge adds ADA to his. . .
body_markdown:
*Alejandro Duque and Guillermo Gonzalez promoted, Elliot Grainge adds ADA to his purview, Val Blavatnik appointed to the executive leadership team*


[Warner Music Group](http://www.wmg.com/) (NASDAQ: WMG) today announced updates to its recorded music leadership structure to power the company’s next chapter of growth. The strategic realignment elevates dynamic executive talent across key territories, optimizes cross-border operations and maximizes the impact of the team’s diverse skill sets.


- **Val Blavatnik** joins the executive team in the new role of **Managing Director, Warner Music North America, UK, & Corporate Development** . Blavatnik will unify and drive business and operational strategy across these markets while guiding the company’s investment strategy to support growth.
- **Alejandro Duque** is elevated to **President, Warner Music International** , adding the APAC and EMEA regions to his remit after quadrupling Warner Music Latin America’s frontline US Latin market share over his five-year tenure. Duque will scale his expertise to drive synergy across territories and strategic investment in the world’s fast-growing markets to accelerate global expansion.
- **Elliot Grainge** expands his remit, becoming **Chairman of ADA** in the US in addition to his current role as Chairman and CEO of Atlantic Music Group, and appoints **Zach Friedman** to serve as **Vice Chairman of ADA** in addition to his COO role at AMG. Leveraging their experience as independent entrepreneurs who built their own successful indie label, 10K Projects, Grainge and Friedman will continue to operate ADA as a standalone business delivering best-in-class service to the independent community.
- **Aaron Bay-Schuck** becomes the sole Chairman and CEO of Warner Records Group. Having transformed Warner Records into an artist-development powerhouse and significantly increased its market share since taking the reins as Co-Chairman and CEO in 2018, Bay-Schuck will lead the label into its next era of growth.
- **Guillermo Gonzalez** is promoted to **President, Warner Music EMEA** after six years powering standout growth at Warner Music Iberia with an artist-first model that has integrated leading live and management businesses and strengthened Warner’s value proposition across Iberia and Latin markets. Andrés Rothschild will take over as **President of Warner Music Iberia** .


At the same time, **Simon Robson** will step down in December after nearly 30 years with the company to pursue new opportunities. Robson has helped shape WMG’s operations in a wide range of markets, promoting new leaders, championing domestic repertoire, and encouraging greater international collaboration.


**Robert Kyncl, CEO of Warner Music Group** , said: “To build upon our successful year in which we delivered on all three strategic priorities to grow market share, increase the value of music, and increase our efficiency, these frontline executive changes enhance our best-in-class leadership team with diverse skill sets to execute on the next chapter of WMG’s growth. Elliot, Aaron, Alejandro, and Guillermo are exceptional, dynamic, and proven leaders who have transformed their domains, and elevating them allows us to further scale their success. I’m also excited to welcome Val to the executive team, where his operational and strategic focus will help us build our momentum across key markets.


Kyncl continued: “We owe a tremendous debt of gratitude to Simon Robson for his dedicated service, operational excellence and trusted leadership while expanding WMG’s global footprint over his remarkable tenure, and wish him the very best in his next endeavors.”
